title: Ken Farley's description of the craft's gold lines
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Ken Farley's description of the craft's gold lines, about 1948 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ken Farley could still describe the craft in perfect detail. At the end, he said, "And around the center section of the craft, there were three brass or copper or gold lines that ran all the way around it."

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, who studies a reported 1948 crash of a flying saucer in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, relays what a man named Ken Farley told about the craft. According to Ramsay, Farley could still describe it in perfect detail late in life, and said three brass, copper or gold lines ran all the way around its center section. Ramsay tells it as a witness detail that, if true, would help show a real craft came down there.
